timing: POST-OUTCOME exploratory: original GPS relative night/day movement v0 effects for these three cohorts were seen and published on this branch before this environmental-link analysis; climate values have NOT been opened for this route. No blinded biological replication or causal mechanism.
goal: Provide source-matched environmental context for the existing unlinked 3 qualified North American Movebank mammal source cohorts. Assess whether near-identical photoperiod and broadly warmer/cooler regional atmosphere uniquely determines sign of source-observed GPS day/night displacement change; do not claim animal temperature causation.
source_cohort: Exactly three source-labeled ORIGINAL GPS Movebank archived bitstreams from the first frozen eight-package extension; no source replacement, sample retuning or new individual roster. Files and provenance in research/MOVEBANK_SOLAR_MOVEMENT_EXTENSION_V0_20261019.json; base previous effects in research/MOVEBANK_SOLAR_MOVEMENT_EXTENSION_V0_RESULT_20261019.json.

mule_deer_wyoming.description: Sublette region, Wyoming, USA; coarse public regional climate reference, not confirmed animal GPS centroid

white_tail_virginia.description: Western Virginia, USA; coarse public regional climate reference, not confirmed animal GPS centroid

wolves_alberta.description: Alberta–British Columbia boundary region; coarse public regional grid may represent some collared packs poorly; never call actual wolf exposure

weather.grid: nearest, model-native elevation; same coarse public place for all matched dates within a source
weather.calendar_timezone: fixed local STANDARD timezone by rounded longitude/15 as in first 3-source ERA5 join, rather than UTC dates; original GPS step date uses mean-solar date; mismatch caveat retained
weather.antecedent_water_proxy: sum of daily precipitation minus reference evapotranspiration ET0 during target date plus prior 29 days, falling minus rising; not soil moisture, vegetation, forage or actual water availability
weather.contrast: for exact original individually retained daylength-matched rising/falling GPS dates, ERA5 falling minus rising daily mean air T and trailing 30d P-ET0

source_safety: First verify that original public package selected bitstream UUID, provider MD5 and file byte count match extension freeze. Do not replace a file whose provider checksum differs.
Recompute the locked source movement mean and eligible number of individuals EXACTLY against archived original v0 result before consulting climate; else HOLD and do not output environment.

No animal IDs, precise track positions, individual event times, raw coordinates, movements, or original telemetry CSV redistributed; only group-level ecological climate/movement comparison and original climate request SHA/URLs.

Keep all original individual years; do not drop animals/dates to increase climate effect signs. Report missing ERA5 source dates explicitly and preserve original group effect separately from climate-qualified restricted effect.

No unit change: movement response is falling−rising [log1p median night km/h − log1p median daylight km/h] from min straight-line GPS displacement per 0.5–2h step. Not true continuous activity, energy expenditure or percent movement.

Do not infer regional daily climate as the exact temperature experienced by an individual, heat stress, circadian entrainment, rainfall-vegetation causation or species-specific response without multiregion replication.

Three extra cohorts plus previous 3 are not six independent experimental regions; overlapping taxonomy and populations/site protocols remain confounded. Prediction accuracy is not required for ecological interpretation.
result_table: source,taxon,DOI,eligible individuals,matched source date-pairs,individual-year count,mean GPS relative night/day response,matched-day regional ERA5 ΔT (°C),matched-day prior 30d Δ(P-ET0) (mm),number of warm-direction animals,number of drier-direction animals,weather source missing pair count,source exact reproduction flag
statistical_limit: Only source-level descriptive contrasts, date dependence and animal nesting recognized; no cross-source naive p-values, causal slopes or pseudo-replicated independent regions. Report the three 3-source past linked contrasts side-by-side without recoding them.
acceptance: Produce genuine source-verified results with a new workflow and tests. If three sources cannot be obtained from original bitstreams, preserve explicit source HOLD; no new simulation or dataset substitution.
